source_issues.description: Full SS14 orderable suffix, qualification grade, procurement identity and user footprint are unresolved. Page 2 illustrates SS16 ordering only. Do not transfer these values to another manufacturer, package, SS12/SS13/SS15/SS16 or assume a numbered pad map.

Actual reverse waveform/spikes, average and peak forward current, pulse repetition, duty cycle, switching frequency and inductive energy are unspecified. Flyback, SMPS, freewheel, polarity-protection or pairing with any MOSFET remains UNKNOWN; generic application labels or ratings alone do not qualify a circuit.

Ambient/lead/junction temperatures, copper geometry, stackup, airflow and coupled heat sources are unprovided. Typical thermal values, pulsed VF/leakage tests and nonrepetitive IFSM cannot certify continuous loss, repetitive surges or thermal stability. No precise Figure 1 knee or missing reverse-surge/avalanche capability is invented.
